canonical.title: Weekend at Subtiel: a De Panne plan around a Michelin Saturday dinner

sources.title: Subtiel — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: Subtiel is a one-star Michelin restaurant at Westhoeklaan 31, De Panne, run by Stéphane Buyens and Ellen Dulst in a seaside villa beside the dunes.

sources.title: Subtiel — official site
sources.claim: Subtiel's official site lists Westhoeklaan 31, 8660 De Panne as the restaurant address with phone 0496 25 21 23.

sources.title: Subtiel — spending the night
sources.claim: Subtiel does not run rooms; the restaurant directs guests to Visit De Panne for accommodation.

sources.title: Dumontwijk — top.vlaanderen
sources.claim: The Dumontwijk is De Panne's oldest villa quarter, designed by Albert Dumont with Art Nouveau and Art Deco cottages.

sources.title: Parkhotel De Panne
sources.claim: Parkhotel sits at Albert Dumontlaan 30 inside the heritage Dumont quarter, ~200 m from the sea, with 39 rooms.

sources.title: B&B Villa Bon Papa
sources.claim: Villa Bon Papa is a 1924 listed villa in the Dumontwijk, A. Dumontlaan 5, 3-minute walk from the beach, rated 9.6.

sources.title: Hotel Donny
sources.claim: Hotel Donny is a 4-star by the sea at Donnylaan 17 with indoor pool, spa, fitness; ~5–7 min walk to Subtiel.

sources.title: B&B Esprit de Mer
sources.claim: B&B Esprit de Mer occupies a former doctor's villa at Visserslaan 10 in the Dumontwijk, ranked #1 of 4 B&Bs in De Panne (4.9/5).

sources.title: Hotel Villa Select
sources.claim: Hotel Villa Select is a 4-star at Walckierstraat 7 with 33 ft from the beach, indoor pool, sauna, Turkish bath, sea-view rooms.

sources.title: Maison Botanique
sources.claim: Self-catering ground-floor apartment in the c.1910 Belle Époque villa Les Lauriers, Bortierlaan 22 in the Dumont quarter.

sources.title: Auberge De Klasse — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: Auberge De Klasse is a heritage-listed 1725 building in central Veurne, ranked #1 of 11 Veurne B&Bs (5/5).

sources.title: Hof ter Duinen
sources.claim: Boutique Hotel Hof ter Duinen, Albert I-Laan 141 Oostduinkerke, 20 rooms, 100 m from dunes and sea, with spa and Bistronomie Eglantier.

sources.title: De Panne ↔ Veurne — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: Taxi De Panne ↔ Veurne is ~7 min for 5 km at roughly €25–35; train 7 min.

sources.title: De Westhoek nature reserve
sources.claim: Westhoek nature reserve at the French border covers 340 ha of dunes, beach, forests and marshes, founded 1957 — Flanders' oldest reserve.

sources.title: De Panne beach
sources.claim: De Panne beach is up to 425 m wide at low tide and over 5 km long — the widest on the Belgian coast.

sources.title: NAVIGO — paardenvissers 2026 calendar
sources.claim: ~40 horseback shrimp fisher demos April–October 2026; ~45 min each, free on the beach.

sources.title: 75th Garnaalfeesten — 27–28 June 2026
sources.claim: The 75th Shrimp Festival is 27–28 June 2026 in Oostduinkerke with parade, folklore market and Belgian Shrimp Peeling Championship.

sources.title: NAVIGO National Fisheries Museum
sources.claim: NAVIGO Oostduinkerke shows North Sea aquariums, a fisherman's house, the OD 1. Martha, sperm whale Valentijn and UNESCO shrimp-fishing heritage.

sources.title: Westfront Nieuwpoort
sources.claim: Westfront Nieuwpoort (under the King Albert I monument) open Tue–Sun 10–17 (10–18 summer); adult €9.50, family €24.

sources.title: IJzertoren Diksmuide — tickets
sources.claim: IJzertoren admission 2026: adults €11.50, children 7–17 €6, students €8, family (2+3) €33.

sources.title: Trench of Death
sources.claim: The Trench of Death (Diksmuide) opens daily 9:30–17:30 from 15 Feb to 30 Nov 2026; adult €12, family €36.

sources.title: Sint-Walburga, Veurne
sources.claim: Veurne's Sint-Walburga church is a Scheldt-Gothic masterwork rising from the centre of town, 12th-century origins, 14th-century Gothic choir.

sources.title: Veurne Wednesday market
sources.claim: Weekly market every Wednesday 8–13 on Grote Markt — flowers, textiles, vegetables, fruit and dairy.

sources.title: Hoge Blekker, Koksijde
sources.claim: Hoge Blekker in Koksijde, 33 m, is the highest dune on the Belgian coast — free, year-round, panoramic sea views.

sources.title: Abdijmuseum Ten Duinen
sources.claim: Abdijmuseum Ten Duinen, Koksijde — Cistercian abbey heritage with visible archaeological foundations.

sources.title: Paul Delvaux Museum
sources.claim: Paul Delvaux Museum, Sint-Idesbald — the artist's former home/studio, 1,000+ m² of the world's largest Delvaux collection.

sources.title: Plopsaland Belgium
sources.claim: Plopsaland Belgium in De Panne (renamed from Plopsaland De Panne in summer 2025) has 55 attractions and 7 rollercoasters.

sources.title: Plopsaqua De Panne
sources.claim: Plopsaqua indoor/outdoor water park: Sky Drop 20 m free-fall slide, Disco Slide, Wild River, Storm Bath; dated tickets from €24.

sources.title: Bergues belfry
sources.claim: UNESCO-listed Bergues belfry: 206 steps, 50-bell carillon — €5 adult / €3 child; Apr–Oct Mon–Sat at 10, 11, 14, 15, 16, 17.

sources.title: Bergues — Hauts-de-France Tourism
sources.claim: Bergues is a fortified Flemish market town with over 5 km of medieval/Vauban ramparts, the setting of Bienvenue chez les Ch'tis.

sources.title: Dunkirk 1940 Museum / Mémorial du Souvenir
sources.claim: Operation Dynamo museum at Bastion 32 opens daily 10–18; €8 adult.

sources.title: FRAC Grand Large — Dunkerque
sources.claim: FRAC Grand Large by Pritzker laureates Lacaton & Vassal opens Wed–Sun 14–18; €8 adult, free on first Sunday.

sources.title: Malo-les-Bains
sources.claim: Malo-les-Bains: 7 km sand beach, 4 km Belle Époque digue lined with terraces and moules-frites stands.

sources.title: Royal Sand Yacht Club
sources.claim: RSYC at Robert Demuyserepad 1 offers sand-yacht initiations on De Panne's 17 km beach up to 450 m wide.

sources.title: De Panne — land yachting
sources.claim: De Panne's wide flat beach is considered the best on the Flemish coast for land yachting.

sources.title: Kusttram
sources.claim: Kusttram is the world's longest metre-gauge tram line — 67 km, 68 stops, De Panne to Knokke-Heist in 2 h 21 min.

sources.title: De Lijn Kusttram
sources.claim: Kusttram runs every 10–20 min by day, every 30 min in the evening.

sources.title: Blue Innovation Village @ Ostend at Anchor 2026
sources.claim: Blue Innovation Village at Ostend at Anchor 2026 runs 28–31 May 2026 at the trade docks — free, 10–18 daily.

sources.title: Ostend at Anchor 2026
sources.claim: Ostend at Anchor: 100+ classic sailing ships, 200,000+ visitors last edition.

sources.title: Ieper ↔ De Panne — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: Road distance Ieper–De Panne is ~37 km / 39 minutes — just beyond the strict 30 km radius.

sources.title: Vladslo German Military Cemetery
sources.claim: Vladslo near Diksmuide holds 25,644 WWI German soldiers and features Käthe Kollwitz's 'Grieving Parents'.

sources.title: De Panne monuments
sources.claim: King Leopold I landed on Belgian soil at De Panne on 17 July 1831; during WWI the royal family lived here, making De Panne the capital of unoccupied Belgium.

sources.title: Subtiel — Gault&Millau
sources.claim: Gault&Millau describes Subtiel as located just outside De Panne's town centre in a converted villa.
